clf-c02.title: Cloud Practitioner
clf-c02.description: 責任共有、料金、基本サービス

cloud-concepts.title: クラウドの価値、責任共有、可用性
cloud-concepts.objective: クラウドの利点と、サービスごとのAWSと利用者の責任を説明できる。リージョンとアベイラビリティーゾーンの違いを、配置の例で説明できる。

security-and-compliance.title: アイデンティティ、アクセス制御、監査
security-and-compliance.objective: 誰がどのリソースに何をできるかを明確にし、最小権限、ポリシー評価、暗号化と監査の役割を説明できる。

technology-and-services.title: 主要サービスを要件から選ぶ
technology-and-services.objective: 処理、保存、データベース、イベント処理という要件を区別し、主要な AWS サービスを用途と運用責任から説明できる。

billing-and-support.title: コストを把握し、予算と支援を選ぶ
billing-and-support.objective: 利用量と料金の関係を理解し、コスト配分、予算通知、料金見積り、サポートプランを事業上の条件から説明できる。

aif-c01.title: AI Practitioner
aif-c01.description: AIと生成AIの基礎、責任ある利用

ai-ml-fundamentals.title: AI と機械学習の基礎
ai-ml-fundamentals.objective: AI、機械学習、生成 AI の役割と、学習から推論、監視までの流れを説明できる。

generative-ai-fundamentals.title: 生成 AI の基礎
generative-ai-fundamentals.objective: プロンプト、トークン、ハルシネーション、RAG を説明し、用途に応じた対策を選べる。

foundation-models.title: 基盤モデルの応用と評価
foundation-models.objective: ユースケースに合うモデルと生成方式を、品質、レイテンシー、コスト、安全性で比較できる。

responsible-ai.title: 責任ある AI
responsible-ai.objective: 公平さ、説明可能性、透明性、安全性、制御性をリスクに結び付けて対策を選べる。

security-and-governance.title: AI ソリューションのセキュリティとガバナンス
security-and-governance.objective: データ、アクセス、出力、監査を保護し、最小権限と継続的な統制を説明できる。

ans-c01.title: Advanced Networking
ans-c01.description: ハイブリッド接続、経路、トラブルシューティング

global-ingress.title: グローバルな入口、DNS、負荷分散を設計する
global-ingress.objective: 利用者、名前解決、エッジ、ロードバランサー、VPC内ターゲットの責任を分け、可用性・遅延・セキュリティ要件から入口を説明できる。

hybrid-and-multivpc.title: ハイブリッド接続とマルチVPCの到達性を設計する
hybrid-and-multivpc.objective: オンプレミス、Direct ConnectまたはSite-to-Site VPN、Transit Gateway、複数VPCの往復経路を、CIDR・BGP広告・ルートテーブル・アタッチメントの責任に分けて説明できる。

vpc-routing.title: VPC内外のルーティングを実装する
vpc-routing.objective: サブネットに関連付くルートテーブル、宛先CIDR、ターゲット、セキュリティ制御を区別し、要求と応答の到達性を検証できる。

network-operations.title: ネットワークを観測し、障害を切り分ける
network-operations.objective: 症状から仮説を立て、経路・許可・ログ・メトリクス・到達性分析を使い分け、変更前後を比較して確認できる。

network-security.title: ネットワークを保護し、監査できる状態にする
network-security.objective: インバウンド、アウトバウンド、VPC間通信、転送中暗号化、ログ・監査を別々の制御点として設計し、要件に対応付けられる。

saa-c03.title: Solutions Architect – Associate
saa-c03.description: 可用性・性能・コストを満たす構成設計

secure-architecture.title: セキュアなアーキテクチャを設計する
secure-architecture.objective: 利用者、データ、通信経路ごとに認証、認可、暗号化、監査の責任を説明できる。

resilient-architecture.title: レジリエントなアーキテクチャを設計する
resilient-architecture.objective: 障害範囲、RTO、RPO、復旧手順から可用性とデータ保護を設計できる。

high-performance-architecture.title: 高パフォーマンスなアーキテクチャを設計する
high-performance-architecture.objective: 要求パターン、データアクセス、ネットワーク経路から性能対策を選べる。

cost-optimized-architecture.title: コストを最適化したアーキテクチャを設計する
cost-optimized-architecture.objective: 利用量、アクセス頻度、可用性要件、運用負荷から費用と制約を比較できる。

clf-c02.title: Cloud Practitioner
clf-c02.description: Shared responsibility, pricing, and core services

cloud-concepts.title: The Value of the Cloud, Shared Responsibility, and Availability
cloud-concepts.objective: Explain the benefits of the cloud and the responsibilities of AWS and the customer for each service. Explain the difference between Regions and Availability Zones using deployment examples.

security-and-compliance.title: Identity, Access Control, and Auditing
security-and-compliance.objective: Explain who can do what to which resources, as well as the roles of least privilege, policy evaluation, encryption, and auditing.

technology-and-services.title: Choose Core Services Based on Requirements
technology-and-services.objective: Distinguish requirements for processing, storage, databases, and event processing, and explain the major AWS services in terms of their intended uses and operational responsibilities.

billing-and-support.title: Understand Costs and Choose Budgeting and Support
billing-and-support.objective: Understand the relationship between usage and pricing, and explain cost allocation, budget notifications, pricing estimates, and support plans based on business requirements.

aif-c01.title: AI Practitioner
aif-c01.description: Fundamentals of AI and generative AI, and responsible AI use

ai-ml-fundamentals.title: AI and Machine Learning Fundamentals
ai-ml-fundamentals.objective: Explain the roles of AI, machine learning, and generative AI, as well as the workflow from training through inference to monitoring.

generative-ai-fundamentals.title: Generative AI Fundamentals
generative-ai-fundamentals.objective: Explain prompts, tokens, hallucinations, and RAG, and choose appropriate countermeasures for each use case.

foundation-models.title: Applications and Evaluation of Foundation Models
foundation-models.objective: Compare models and generation methods that fit a use case based on quality, latency, cost, and safety.

responsible-ai.title: Responsible AI
responsible-ai.objective: Be able to select measures by linking fairness, explainability, transparency, safety, and controllability to risks.

security-and-governance.title: Security and Governance for AI Solutions
security-and-governance.objective: Explain how to protect data, access, outputs, and audits, and how to apply least privilege and continuous controls.

global-ingress.title: Designing Global Entry Points, DNS, and Load Balancing
global-ingress.objective: Distinguish the responsibilities of users, name resolution, the edge, load balancers, and targets within a VPC, and explain entry points based on availability, latency, and security requirements.

hybrid-and-multivpc.title: Designing Reachability for Hybrid Connectivity and Multiple VPCs
hybrid-and-multivpc.objective: Explain the responsibilities of CIDR blocks, BGP advertisements, route tables, and attachments when designing bidirectional paths among on-premises environments, Direct Connect or Site-to-Site VPN, Transit Gateway, and multiple VPCs.

vpc-routing.title: Implement routing within and outside a VPC
vpc-routing.objective: Distinguish the route tables associated with subnets, destination CIDRs, targets, and security controls, and verify the reachability of requests and responses.

network-operations.title: Observe networks and troubleshoot failures
network-operations.objective: Form hypotheses from symptoms, choose appropriately among path analysis, permissions, logs, metrics, and reachability analysis, and verify changes by comparing the states before and after.

network-security.title: Secure the network and make it auditable
network-security.objective: Design inbound traffic, outbound traffic, VPC-to-VPC communication, encryption in transit, and logging and auditing as separate control points, and map them to the requirements.

saa-c03.title: Solutions Architect – Associate
saa-c03.description: Architecture design that meets availability, performance, and cost requirements

secure-architecture.title: Designing a Secure Architecture
secure-architecture.objective: Explain the responsibilities for authentication, authorization, encryption, and auditing for users, data, and communication paths.

resilient-architecture.title: Designing Resilient Architectures
resilient-architecture.objective: Design availability and data protection based on failure scope, RTO, RPO, and recovery procedures.

high-performance-architecture.title: Designing High-Performance Architectures
high-performance-architecture.objective: Choose performance optimizations based on request patterns, data access, and network paths.

cost-optimized-architecture.title: Design a cost-optimized architecture
cost-optimized-architecture.objective: Compare costs and constraints based on usage volume, access frequency, availability requirements, and operational burden.

clf-c02.title: Cloud Practitioner
clf-c02.description: 责任共担、费用与基础服务

cloud-concepts.title: 云的价值、责任共担与可用性
cloud-concepts.objective: 能够说明云的优势，以及对于不同服务，AWS 和客户各自承担的责任。能够通过部署示例说明区域与可用区之间的区别。

security-and-compliance.title: 身份、访问控制与审计
security-and-compliance.objective: 能够明确谁可以对哪些资源执行哪些操作，并说明最小权限、策略评估、加密和审计的作用。

technology-and-services.title: 根据需求选择主要服务
technology-and-services.objective: 区分处理、存储、数据库和事件处理等需求，并根据用途和运维责任说明主要的 AWS 服务。

billing-and-support.title: 了解成本并选择预算与支持方案
billing-and-support.objective: 理解使用量与费用之间的关系，并能根据业务条件说明成本分配、预算通知、费用估算和支持计划。

aif-c01.title: AI Practitioner
aif-c01.description: AI 与生成式 AI 基础、负责任地使用 AI

ai-ml-fundamentals.title: AI 与机器学习基础
ai-ml-fundamentals.objective: 能够说明 AI、机器学习和生成式 AI 的作用，以及从训练到推理再到监控的流程。

generative-ai-fundamentals.title: 生成式 AI 基础
generative-ai-fundamentals.objective: 能够解释提示词、令牌、幻觉和 RAG，并根据使用场景选择适当的对策。

foundation-models.title: 基础模型的应用与评估
foundation-models.objective: 能够根据质量、延迟、成本和安全性，比较适合用例的模型与生成方式。

responsible-ai.title: 负责任的 AI
responsible-ai.objective: 能够将公平性、可解释性、透明性、安全性和可控性与风险联系起来，选择相应的措施。

security-and-governance.title: AI 解决方案的安全与治理
security-and-governance.objective: 能够说明如何保护数据、访问权限、输出和审计，并实施最小权限和持续治理。

ans-c01.title: Advanced Networking
ans-c01.description: 混合连接、路由与故障排查

global-ingress.title: 设计全球入口、DNS 和负载均衡
global-ingress.objective: 区分用户、名称解析、边缘、负载均衡器以及 VPC 内目标的职责，并根据可用性、延迟和安全性要求说明入口。

hybrid-and-multivpc.title: 设计混合连接与多 VPC 的可达性
hybrid-and-multivpc.objective: 能够区分 CIDR、BGP 通告、路由表和 Transit Gateway 附件（attachment）的作用，并说明本地网络、Direct Connect 或 Site-to-Site VPN、Transit Gateway 和多个 VPC 之间的双向路径。

vpc-routing.title: 实施 VPC 内外的路由
vpc-routing.objective: 区分与子网关联的路由表、目标 CIDR、目标以及安全控制，并验证请求和响应的可达性。

network-operations.title: 观测网络并排查故障
network-operations.objective: 根据症状提出假设，合理选择路径、权限、日志、指标和可达性分析，并通过比较变更前后的状态进行确认。

network-security.title: 保护网络并使其具备可审计性
network-security.objective: 将入站流量、出站流量、VPC 之间的通信、传输中加密以及日志记录与审计设计为彼此独立的控制点，并将其与相关要求对应起来。

saa-c03.title: Solutions Architect – Associate
saa-c03.description: 满足可用性、性能和成本要求的架构设计

secure-architecture.title: 设计安全架构
secure-architecture.objective: 能够说明针对用户、数据和通信路径分别承担的身份验证、授权、加密和审计责任。

resilient-architecture.title: 设计具有弹性的架构
resilient-architecture.objective: 根据故障范围、RTO、RPO 和恢复流程设计可用性与数据保护方案。

high-performance-architecture.title: 设计高性能架构
high-performance-architecture.objective: 能够根据请求模式、数据访问方式和网络路径选择性能优化措施。

cost-optimized-architecture.title: 设计成本优化的架构
cost-optimized-architecture.objective: 根据使用量、访问频率、可用性要求和运营负担比较成本与约束条件。

clf-c02.title: Cloud Practitioner
clf-c02.description: 責任共擔、費用與基礎服務

cloud-concepts.title: 雲端的價值、責任共擔與可用性
cloud-concepts.objective: 能夠說明雲端的優點，以及針對不同服務，AWS 與客戶各自負責的事項。能夠透過部署範例說明區域與可用區之間的差異。

security-and-compliance.title: 身分、存取控制與稽核
security-and-compliance.objective: 能明確說明誰可以對哪些資源執行哪些操作，並解釋最小權限、政策評估、加密與稽核的作用。

technology-and-services.title: 依需求選擇主要服務
technology-and-services.objective: 區分處理、儲存、資料庫與事件處理等需求，並從用途與營運責任的角度說明主要的 AWS 服務。

billing-and-support.title: 掌握成本並選擇預算與支援方案
billing-and-support.objective: 了解用量與費用之間的關係，並能根據業務條件說明成本分配、預算通知、費用估算與支援方案。

aif-c01.title: AI Practitioner
aif-c01.description: AI 與生成式 AI 基礎、負責任的使用

ai-ml-fundamentals.title: AI 與機器學習基礎
ai-ml-fundamentals.objective: 能夠說明 AI、機器學習與生成式 AI 的作用，以及從訓練到推論再到監控的流程。

generative-ai-fundamentals.title: 生成式 AI 基礎
generative-ai-fundamentals.objective: 能夠說明提示、權杖、幻覺與 RAG，並依據使用情境選擇適當的對策。

foundation-models.title: 基礎模型的應用與評估
foundation-models.objective: 能夠根據品質、延遲、成本和安全性，比較適合使用案例的模型與生成方式。

responsible-ai.title: 負責任的 AI
responsible-ai.objective: 能夠將公平性、可解釋性、透明度、安全性與可控性與風險相互關聯，選擇相應的措施。

security-and-governance.title: AI 解決方案的安全性與治理
security-and-governance.objective: 能夠說明如何保護資料、存取權限、輸出與稽核，並實施最小權限與持續治理。

ans-c01.title: Advanced Networking
ans-c01.description: 混合式連線、路由與疑難排解

global-ingress.title: 設計全球入口、DNS 與負載平衡
global-ingress.objective: 區分使用者、名稱解析、邊緣、負載平衡器及 VPC 內目標的職責，並根據可用性、延遲與安全性需求說明入口。

hybrid-and-multivpc.title: 設計混合連線與多個 VPC 的可達性
hybrid-and-multivpc.objective: 能區分 CIDR、BGP 通告、路由表及 Transit Gateway 附件（attachment）的作用，並說明內部部署網路、Direct Connect 或 Site-to-Site VPN、Transit Gateway 與多個 VPC 之間的雙向路徑。

vpc-routing.title: 實作 VPC 內外的路由
vpc-routing.objective: 區分與子網路關聯的路由表、目的地 CIDR、目標和安全控制，並驗證請求與回應的可達性。

network-operations.title: 觀測網路並排查故障
network-operations.objective: 根據症狀提出假設，適當運用路徑、權限、日誌、指標和可達性分析，並透過比較變更前後的狀態來確認。

network-security.title: 保護網路並使其具備可稽核性
network-security.objective: 將入站流量、出站流量、VPC 之間的通訊、傳輸中加密，以及記錄日誌與稽核設計為彼此獨立的控制點，並將其對應至相關需求。

saa-c03.title: Solutions Architect – Associate
saa-c03.description: 符合可用性、效能與成本需求的架構設計

secure-architecture.title: 設計安全架構
secure-architecture.objective: 能夠說明針對使用者、資料和通訊路徑，分別由誰負責身分驗證、授權、加密和稽核。

resilient-architecture.title: 設計具韌性的架構
resilient-architecture.objective: 根據故障範圍、RTO、RPO 與復原程序，設計可用性與資料保護方案。

high-performance-architecture.title: 設計高效能架構
high-performance-architecture.objective: 能夠根據請求模式、資料存取方式和網路路徑選擇效能最佳化措施。

cost-optimized-architecture.title: 設計成本最佳化的架構
cost-optimized-architecture.objective: 根據使用量、存取頻率、可用性需求與營運負擔比較成本和限制條件。

clf-c02.title: Cloud Practitioner
clf-c02.description: 공동 책임, 요금 및 핵심 서비스

cloud-concepts.title: 클라우드의 가치, 공동 책임 및 가용성
cloud-concepts.objective: 클라우드의 이점과 각 서비스에 대한 AWS와 고객의 책임을 설명할 수 있다. 배포 사례를 통해 리전과 가용 영역의 차이를 설명할 수 있다.

security-and-compliance.title: 자격 증명, 액세스 제어 및 감사
security-and-compliance.objective: 누가 어떤 리소스에 대해 무엇을 할 수 있는지 명확히 설명하고, 최소 권한, 정책 평가, 암호화 및 감사의 역할을 설명할 수 있다.

technology-and-services.title: 요구 사항에 따라 주요 서비스 선택하기
technology-and-services.objective: 처리, 저장, 데이터베이스, 이벤트 처리라는 요구 사항을 구분하고, 용도와 운영 책임을 기준으로 주요 AWS 서비스를 설명할 수 있습니다.

billing-and-support.title: 비용을 파악하고 예산과 지원을 선택하기
billing-and-support.objective: 사용량과 요금의 관계를 이해하고, 비즈니스 조건을 바탕으로 비용 배분, 예산 알림, 요금 추정 및 지원 플랜을 설명할 수 있습니다.

aif-c01.title: AI Practitioner
aif-c01.description: AI와 생성형 AI의 기초, 책임 있는 활용

ai-ml-fundamentals.title: AI 및 머신 러닝 기초
ai-ml-fundamentals.objective: AI, 머신 러닝, 생성형 AI의 역할과 학습부터 추론, 모니터링까지의 흐름을 설명할 수 있다.

generative-ai-fundamentals.title: 생성형 AI 기초
generative-ai-fundamentals.objective: 프롬프트, 토큰, 환각, RAG를 설명하고 사용 사례에 맞는 대책을 선택할 수 있다.

foundation-models.title: 기반 모델의 활용과 평가
foundation-models.objective: 품질, 지연 시간, 비용 및 안전성을 기준으로 사용 사례에 적합한 모델과 생성 방식을 비교할 수 있다.

responsible-ai.title: 책임 있는 AI
responsible-ai.objective: 공정성, 설명 가능성, 투명성, 안전성, 제어 가능성을 위험과 연계하여 대책을 선택할 수 있다.

security-and-governance.title: AI 솔루션의 보안 및 거버넌스

network-security.objective: Diseñar el tráfico entrante, el tráfico saliente, la comunicación entre VPC, el cifrado en tránsito y el registro y la auditoría como puntos de control independientes, y asignarlos a los requisitos correspondientes.

saa-c03.title: Solutions Architect – Associate
saa-c03.description: Diseño de arquitectura que cumpla los requisitos de disponibilidad, rendimiento y costo

secure-architecture.title: Diseñar una arquitectura segura
secure-architecture.objective: Explicar las responsabilidades de autenticación, autorización, cifrado y auditoría para los usuarios, los datos y las rutas de comunicación.

resilient-architecture.title: Diseñar arquitecturas resilientes
resilient-architecture.objective: Diseñar la disponibilidad y la protección de datos en función del alcance de la falla, el RTO, el RPO y los procedimientos de recuperación.

high-performance-architecture.title: Diseño de arquitecturas de alto rendimiento
high-performance-architecture.objective: Elegir optimizaciones de rendimiento en función de los patrones de solicitudes, el acceso a los datos y las rutas de red.

cost-optimized-architecture.title: Diseñar una arquitectura optimizada en costos
cost-optimized-architecture.objective: Comparar los costos y las restricciones en función del volumen de uso, la frecuencia de acceso, los requisitos de disponibilidad y la carga operativa.

clf-c02.title: Cloud Practitioner
clf-c02.description: Responsabilità condivisa, prezzi e servizi essenziali

cloud-concepts.title: Il valore del cloud, la responsabilità condivisa e la disponibilità
cloud-concepts.objective: Saper spiegare i vantaggi del cloud e le responsabilità di AWS e del cliente per ciascun servizio. Saper spiegare la differenza tra Regioni e zone di disponibilità usando esempi di implementazione.

security-and-compliance.title: Identità, controllo degli accessi e auditing
security-and-compliance.objective: Spiegare chi può fare cosa su quali risorse e illustrare il ruolo del principio del privilegio minimo, della valutazione delle policy, della crittografia e dell’auditing.

technology-and-services.title: Scegliere i servizi principali in base ai requisiti
technology-and-services.objective: Distinguere i requisiti relativi a elaborazione, archiviazione, database ed elaborazione degli eventi, e spiegare i principali servizi AWS in base al loro utilizzo e alle responsabilità operative.

billing-and-support.title: Comprendere i costi e scegliere budget e supporto
billing-and-support.objective: Comprendere la relazione tra utilizzo e prezzi e spiegare l’allocazione dei costi, le notifiche sul budget, le stime dei prezzi e i piani di supporto in base alle condizioni aziendali.

aif-c01.title: AI Practitioner
aif-c01.description: Fondamenti di IA e IA generativa, uso responsabile

ai-ml-fundamentals.title: Fondamenti di IA e machine learning
ai-ml-fundamentals.objective: Spiegare i ruoli dell’IA, del machine learning e dell’IA generativa, nonché il flusso che va dall’addestramento all’inferenza e al monitoraggio.

generative-ai-fundamentals.title: Fondamenti dell’IA generativa
generative-ai-fundamentals.objective: Spiegare prompt, token, allucinazioni e RAG e scegliere le contromisure appropriate in base al caso d’uso.

foundation-models.title: Applicazioni e valutazione dei modelli di base
foundation-models.objective: Confrontare i modelli e i metodi di generazione adatti a un caso d’uso in base a qualità, latenza, costi e sicurezza.

responsible-ai.title: IA responsabile
responsible-ai.objective: Essere in grado di selezionare misure collegando equità, spiegabilità, trasparenza, sicurezza e controllabilità ai rischi.

security-and-governance.title: Sicurezza e governance delle soluzioni di IA
security-and-governance.objective: Spiegare come proteggere i dati, gli accessi, gli output e gli audit, nonché come applicare il principio del privilegio minimo e controlli continui.

ans-c01.title: Advanced Networking
ans-c01.description: Connettività ibrida, routing e risoluzione dei problemi

global-ingress.title: Progettare punti di ingresso globali, DNS e bilanciamento del carico
global-ingress.objective: Distinguere le responsabilità degli utenti, della risoluzione dei nomi, dell’edge, dei load balancer e delle destinazioni all’interno di una VPC, e spiegare i punti di ingresso in base ai requisiti di disponibilità, latenza e sicurezza.

hybrid-and-multivpc.title: Progettare la raggiungibilità per la connettività ibrida e più VPC
hybrid-and-multivpc.objective: Spiegare le responsabilità dei blocchi CIDR, degli annunci BGP, delle tabelle di routing e degli attachment nella progettazione dei percorsi bidirezionali tra ambienti on-premises, Direct Connect o Site-to-Site VPN, Transit Gateway e più VPC.

vpc-routing.title: Implementare il routing all’interno e all’esterno di una VPC
vpc-routing.objective: Distinguere le tabelle di routing associate alle sottoreti, i CIDR di destinazione, le destinazioni e i controlli di sicurezza, quindi verificare la raggiungibilità delle richieste e delle risposte.

network-operations.title: Osservare la rete e diagnosticare i problemi
network-operations.objective: Formulare ipotesi a partire dai sintomi, scegliere opportunamente tra analisi dei percorsi, delle autorizzazioni, dei log, delle metriche e della raggiungibilità, quindi verificare le modifiche confrontando lo stato prima e dopo.

network-security.title: Proteggere la rete e prepararla per gli audit
network-security.objective: Progettare il traffico in ingresso, il traffico in uscita, la comunicazione tra VPC, la crittografia in transito, nonché la registrazione dei log e l’audit come punti di controllo distinti, associandoli ai requisiti.

saa-c03.title: Solutions Architect – Associate
saa-c03.description: Progettazione di un'architettura che soddisfi i requisiti di disponibilità, prestazioni e costi

secure-architecture.title: Progettare un'architettura sicura
secure-architecture.objective: Spiegare le responsabilità relative ad autenticazione, autorizzazione, crittografia e auditing per utenti, dati e percorsi di comunicazione.

resilient-architecture.title: Progettare architetture resilienti
resilient-architecture.objective: Progettare la disponibilità e la protezione dei dati in base all’ambito del guasto, a RTO e RPO e alle procedure di ripristino.

high-performance-architecture.title: Progettare architetture ad alte prestazioni
high-performance-architecture.objective: Scegliere le ottimizzazioni delle prestazioni in base ai pattern delle richieste, all’accesso ai dati e ai percorsi di rete.

cost-optimized-architecture.title: Progettare un’architettura ottimizzata in termini di costi
cost-optimized-architecture.objective: Confrontare costi e vincoli in base al volume di utilizzo, alla frequenza di accesso, ai requisiti di disponibilità e al carico operativo.
